scope: Audit-only exact-action capability map. The live UI must still use its source catalogue and source-defined prerequisites. This file grants no new transports or firmware compatibility.

integrated-load.meaning: The existing exact-file action has a source-backed network transport. A successful send is not proof that a menu appeared in the game.
integrated-load.requirements: Use the exact action prerequisites, running compatible loader and configured target address. Do not expand support from the file extension.

native-game-plugin.workflow: Install the complete matching support files, preserve the existing plugins.ini, enable only the title-matched plugin and launch the exact game build. A replacement-only PRX is not a complete first installation.
native-game-plugin.integrationLimit: No source-backed public HTTP PRX/SPRX launch endpoint was established. Download must not be renamed to Load; do not send a game module to a raw BIN or ELF listener.

native-cheat-manager.workflow: Save the exact title/update definition to the documented native-manager directory, open the matching game and enable the desired cheats in its console menu.
native-cheat-manager.integrationLimit: MC4/JSON definitions are data. No generic BIN/ELF Load operation applies.

original-host-payload.workflow: Download the preserved ready BIN or use its separately labelled original host.
original-host-payload.integrationLimit: No matching direct HTTP mapping for this exact source variant and game pin. An external-host URL must not masquerade as an integrated Load button.

original-host-page.workflow: Open the credited original site. A locally implemented bootstrap requires separately reviewed assets, exact firmware pins and a real loader.
original-host-page.integrationLimit: Navigating to a host is not built-in payload execution.

initial-loader-bootstrap.workflow: Follow the selected exploit initial basic-loader instructions before using the persistent 9021 loader. Initial 9020 and persistent 9021 are distinct stages.
initial-loader-bootstrap.integrationLimit: The catalogue has no run method for this bootstrap action; do not invent one from ELF extension alone.

game-save-bootstrap.workflow: Follow the exact game-save loader instructions, account-matched save and game requirements.
game-save-bootstrap.integrationLimit: This is not a web page that automatically runs a Lua script. Do not alias the separate Lua sender or save installation to raw ELF/BIN Load.

goldhen-http.request: Check /status for status=ready, then POST unchanged ArrayBuffer to /. Original Nazky source uses POST for loopback status and GET for remote address status.
prerequisites: Exact curated BIN and PS4 firmware 9.00 source pin
GoldHEN HTTP BinLoader enabled and ready
Correct exact GTA V/RDR2 game update; retain all existing action requirements
limits: HTTP acceptance is not in-game success.
Do not replace a failed status/readiness check with silent external-host navigation.
Raw TCP and HTTP are distinct protocols even if both use port 9090.

elf-tcp.request: A paired local sender transmits unchanged verified ELF bytes over TCP to an already running compatible elfldr.
prerequisites: Compatible PS4 elfldr already running and listening on TCP 9021
Paired sender; browser JavaScript has no raw TCP socket
limits: An ELF transfer is not evidence of service startup.
No numeric firmware range is inferred where the catalogue has none.

elf-http.request: The existing direct action opens the documented elfldr URI-fetch request; the paired sender can instead send verified local ELF bytes.
prerequisites: Already jailbroken compatible PS5 with persistent elfldr
ELF URL reachable from the console; localhost desktop URL is not a console URL
Remote TCP requires a LAN-bound listener; loopback-only autoloaders need the native local manager
limits: HTTP 200 precedes downloading/spawning and does not prove payload success.
PS5 Payload Manager service on 8084 is separate and restricts browser origins.
